cinematic.wildernessodysseyapi.cryo.obje: Objective: Find a way out of the facility.
cinematic.wildernessodysseyapi.cryo.narr: Warning. Suspension medium contamination exceeds safe threshold.
Administering emergency vasopressor and reanimation compound.
Cardiac activity remains below recovery threshold.
Engaging cardiac pacing in three... two... one.
Motor response detected. Do not stand too quickly.
I am A.E.T.H.E.R, the central expedition intelligence. Or what remains of it.
My records are incomplete, and much of this facility is no longer responding.
Find a way out. I will guide you when I can.
message.wildernessodysseyapi.anomaly_gat: [Anomaly Gateway] The frame hums, but this dimension cannot tune the signal.

[Anomaly Gateway] The dimension you entered from no longer answers.
[Anomaly Gateway] The temporal scar aligns. You cross into the Anomaly.
[Anomaly Gateway] The scar releases you beside your original gateway.

Real local Weather authority inspection and bounded 3x3-cell experiments.
Real custom-water authority, generated spans, watershed state, and diagnostics.
Current loaded chunk, biome, generator, height, and structure inspection.
Real block and entity data collected by the Wilderness Developer Tool.
